==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|confirme||obsolete}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*dʰer-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|confirmen}}, {{m|enm|confermen}}, from {{der|en|fro|confermer}}, from {{der|en|la|confirmo|cōnfirmāre|to make firm, strengthen, establish}}, from {{m|la|con-||together}} + {{m|la|firmo|firmāre|to make firm}}, from {{m|la|firmus||firm}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈfɜːm/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈfɝm/|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-confirm.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|a=Indic|/kənˈfɜ(r)m/}}
** {{IPA|en|a=rounded,proscribed|/kənˈfɔ(r)m/}}
*** {{hmp|en|conform}}

* {{rhymes|en|ɜː(ɹ)m|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|con|firm}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# To [[strengthen]]; to make [[firm]] or [[resolute]].
# {{lb|en|transitive|Christianity}} To [[administer]] the [[sacrament]] of [[confirmation]] on (someone).
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1971|author={{w|Keith Thomas (historian)|Keith Thomas}}|title=Religion and the Decline of Magic|page=35|publisher=Folio Society|year_published=2012
|passage=Elizabeth, daughter of Henry VIII, was baptized and '''confirmed''' at the age of three days.}}
# To [[assure]] the [[accuracy]] of previous statements.
#* {{quote-video game|en|developer=w:BioWare|title={{w|Mass Effect (video game)|Mass Effect}}|location=Redwood City|publisher=Electronic Arts|year=2008|genre=[[science fiction|Science Fiction]]|system=PC|scene=Protheans: Data Discs Codex entry|isbn=9780784546642|oclc=246633669|passage=Despite all the evidence '''confirming''' the existence of the Protheans, little is known about their culture and society. From time to time, dig sites will yield new clues, but after 50,000 years of decay, little of value is unearthed.}}
#* {{quote-web|en|author=Steven Pifer|work=Five years after Crimea’s illegal annexation, the issue is no closer to resolution
|url=https://cisac.fsi.stanford.edu/news/five-years-after-crimea’s-illegal-annexation-issue-no-closer-resolution|publisher=The Center for International Security and Cooperation|date=18 March 2019|passage= The little green men were clearly professional soldiers by their bearing, carried Russian weapons, and wore Russian combat fatigues, but they had no identifying insignia. Vladimir Putin originally denied they were Russian soldiers; that April, he '''confirmed''' they were.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260624010701/https://cisac.fsi.stanford.edu/news/five-years-after-crimea%E2%80%99s-illegal-annexation-issue-no-closer-resolution|archivedate=24 June 2026}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To approve a proposal or nomination.
#: {{ux|en|The Senate must '''confirm''' federal court appointments.}}

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|to strengthen}} ''See'' [[Thesaurus:strengthen]]
* {{sense|to affirm the accuracy of}} {{l|en|corroborate}}; {{l|en|roborate}} {{q|obs.}}, {{l|en|attest}}
* {{sense|to approve}} {{l|en|roborate}} {{q|obs.}}

* {{l|en|deny}}
* {{l|en|dispute}}
